springpressure.name: Spring Pressure
springpressure.desc: Full local Static and Pressure, including their field effects. Pressure has its once-per-opponent entry memory.

summerpressure.name: Summer Pressure
summerpressure.desc: Full local Flame Body and Pressure, including their field effects. Pressure has its once-per-opponent entry memory.

winterpressure.name: Winter Pressure
winterpressure.desc: Full local Ice Body and Pressure, including their field effects. Pressure has its once-per-opponent entry memory.

springherald.name: Spring Herald
springherald.shortDesc: Drizzle. Its Electric attacks spare allies.
springherald.desc: Full local Drizzle. Its damaging Electric moves do not hit allies.

springtempest.name: Spring Tempest
springtempest.desc: Full local Lightning Rod and Storm Power: redirects and absorbs Electric moves; rain boosts Sp. Atk by 1.5x and costs 1/8 max HP each turn.

summerherald.name: Summer Herald
summerherald.shortDesc: Drought. Fire immunity; opposing Fire heals 1/8 HP once per turn.
summerherald.desc: Full local Drought. Immune to Fire moves. An opposing Fire move heals 1/8 max HP, at most once per turn; allied Fire moves do not heal it.

summerrenewal.name: Summer Renewal
summerrenewal.desc: Full local Regenerator and Solar Power, including their field effects and Solar Power HP cost.

winterherald.name: Winter Herald
winterherald.shortDesc: Snow Warning. In hail/snow, foes cannot lower allied Speed.
winterherald.desc: Full local Snow Warning. While hail or snow is effective, opponents cannot lower its or its active allies' Speed.

winterrefuge.name: Winter Refuge
winterrefuge.desc: Full local Friend Guard and Ice Scales, including their field effects.

cometheart.name: Comet Heart
cometheart.desc: Levitate. Its Doom Desire has 1.5x power.

wishkeeper.name: Wishkeeper
wishkeeper.shortDesc: Magic Bounce + Triage. Its Wish also cures the receiver's status.
wishkeeper.desc: Magic Bounce and Triage. When its Wish resolves, it cures the receiver's major status even at full HP.

yearningstar.name: Yearning Star
yearningstar.shortDesc: Charge moves, Wish, Future Sight and Doom Desire resolve immediately.
yearningstar.desc: Skips charge turns. Wish, Future Sight and Doom Desire resolve during their use, without leaving a delayed effect. Charge boosts, move costs and recharge turns remain.

dreamsickness.shortDesc: Insomnia + Sworn Duty; once per battle rescues an adjacent ally from a lethal attack.
dreamsickness.desc: Prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn and boosts Dark/Ghost attacks by 1.3x. On entry, heals adjacent allies by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale. Once per battle, saves an adjacent ally from a lethal opposing attack at 1 HP through the remainder of that move, paying 1/4 of the holder’s max HP. The holder must have more HP than the cost. Switching does not restore the rescue.

rubblewake.name: Rubblewake
rubblewake.shortDesc: Once per entry, surviving a physical hit sets Spikes on the attacker's side.
rubblewake.desc: Once per switch-in, after surviving a physical attack that damages its HP, sets one layer of Spikes on the attacker's side.

eternalice.name: Eternal Ice
eternalice.shortDesc: Immune to Fire and burns; damaging moves cannot lower its stats.
eternalice.desc: Immune to Fire moves and burns. Prevents negative stat changes caused by damaging moves, including its own moves. Status moves can still lower its stats.

temperedalloy.name: Tempered Alloy
temperedalloy.shortDesc: Filter. Immune to damaging-move secondary effects.
temperedalloy.desc: Filter. Blocks secondary effects of damaging moves that would affect it; effects on the attacker still apply.

unsealedcurrent.name: Unsealed Current
unsealedcurrent.shortDesc: Once per battle, a hit crossing half HP raises Sp. Atk by 1.
unsealedcurrent.desc: Once per battle, surviving a damaging move that takes it from above half HP to half HP or less raises its Sp. Atk by 1.

crystalfocus.name: Crystal Focus
crystalfocus.shortDesc: Dragon attacks ignore positive defensive stages and screens.
crystalfocus.desc: Its Dragon attacks ignore the target's positive Defense or Sp. Def stages and Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil.

ancientassembly.name: Ancient Assembly
ancientassembly.shortDesc: Allied Regis shorten Slow Start; in Primordial form, boost damage.
ancientassembly.desc: Each different allied Regirock, Regice, Registeel, Regieleki or Regidrago that enters battle shortens its Slow Start by 1 turn, up to 3 turns. In Primordial form, each instead adds 10% damage, up to 30%. Each species counts once per battle.
